files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/publish.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+name: publish
+on:
+  pull_request_target:
+    branches: [main]
+permissions: write-all
+jobs:
+  publish:
+    uses: some-org/release-tools/.github/workflows/docker-publish.yml@v4
+    with:
+      image_name: core-api
+    secrets: inherit

note: Isolated defects: floating v4 tag (mutable, not a pinned SHA); secrets: inherit exposes every secret; plus write-all permissions and no fork guard.
